name: l5_vertical_loaded_cycles_v1
description: Supported-chassis L5 five-cycle constant-radius vertical flex excitation. Approach x=180/y=120 mm contact, cycle five times to y=145 mm and back along the same radial line, retract to unloaded y=60, return to zero, and limp. Used to measure current/encoder/camera hysteresis and accumulating residual shift. Soft torque 700; trip after three consecutive readings above 0.75 A; immediate ceiling 3.0 A.
